title: 第3章 大师兄黎漠第4章 是误会
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
系统整个人都不好了，他在宋荞脑海中尖声叫着：“宿主，你这样完成任务，是不对的……没有人像你这样的！”
宋荞有些不耐烦：“我完成任务，对你来说，不也是一件好事吗？”
系统：“……你现在把楚风眠得罪成这样，他要是不肯跟你生孩子了怎么办？宿主，我劝你立刻道歉，将他重新笼络回来。”
宋荞忍不住翻了个白眼。
系统在脑海中碎碎念着，她面前，楚风眠也是一脸笃定，他死死盯着宋荞，就等着她低声下气求他原谅。
“宋荞，你听见我说的话吗？”楚风眠厉声说道：“我和你，完了！”
“很好，那我们达成共识了。”宋荞淡然丢下一句话，然后，转身就走了。
楚风眠看着她的背影，整个人都愣住了。
宋荞……还真敢就这么把他丢下？
她怎么敢的？
她就不怕自己再也不要她了吗？
“宿主！你这样哪怕拿到了生子丹，没人跟你生孩子，又有什么用！楚风眠好歹也是男主，你就忍一忍，先哄哄啊！”系统还在碎碎念着。
宋荞直接打开了门，毫不犹豫地离开了。
她的眸底闪动着一丝光芒。
她原本只是试验一下，没想到，这样真能完成任务。
那这生子丹……也未必不能操作操作。
宋荞目光一动，打断了系统的碎碎念：“使用生子丹的具体规则是什么，详细说说。”
系统的声音顿时欢快了起来：“宿主，你终于想通啦？本统这就给你讲解。
生子丹的使用方法很简单，只要宿主你吃下这颗丹药，再和异性春风一度，就百分百能够怀上孩子。孩子父亲的天赋越好，实力越强，孩子的天赋高的概率也就越大。之后，宿主你只要好好培养孩子，孩子越厉害，宿主你也会得到提升的！”
宋荞细细听着，然后问道：“要是我把生子丹给别人呢？能不能生效？”

系统愣了一下，然后说道：“生效是能生效。曾经有个宿主就这么干过，她把生子丹给了朋友，朋友生下孩子后，她更是悉心培养那个孩子。但不是亲生的孩子，始终养不熟，那孩子嫌弃她管的太多，竟是联合他的亲生母亲，将那位宿主给灭杀了。那位宿主……啧啧啧，费心费力不讨好啊，这位宿主真是可怜啊。
那之后，就没有宿主会把生子丹给别人吃了。”
“那就是可以给别人吃。”宋荞无视掉系统，直接得出了结论。
系统不由郁闷了：“宿主，你到底有没有听我说话？”
宋荞心中已经有了打算，只当系统的话是耳边风。
她还没走几步路，突然，一道清冷的声音响了起来。
“宋师妹。”
宋荞抬起头来，入目就是一张清冷孤傲的绝色容貌。
机械的声音响了起来。
【滴，检测到符合条件的天骄。】
【黎漠：灵心宗大师兄。灵根：上等。心性：超等。悟性：上等。根骨：上等。气运：中等。】
【触发天骄攻略任务：和黎漠深情相拥十秒钟。任务奖励：进化之水。让刚出生的孩子喝下进化之水，有几率提升孩子资质。】
【任务时限：一个月。一个月未完成，则任务消失。】
机械声一结束。
content_en:
The whole system was in trouble, and he screamed in Song Qiao's mind: "Host, it's not right for you to complete the task like this... There is no one like you!"
Song Qiao was a little impatient: "If I complete the task, isn't it also a good thing for you?"
System: "...You have offended Chu Fengmian so much now. What if he refuses to have a child with you? Host, I advise you to apologize immediately and win him back."
Song Qiao couldn't help but rolled his eyes.
The system was thinking about it in his mind. In front of her, Chu Fengmian also looked determined. He stared at Song Qiao, waiting for her to beg him for forgiveness in a low voice.
"Song Qiao, did you hear what I said?" Chu Fengmian said sternly: "You and I are finished!"
"Very good, then we have reached a consensus." Song Qiao said a word calmly, then turned and left.
Chu Fengmian looked at her back and was stunned.
Song Qiao... really dare to leave him like this?
How dare she?
Isn't she afraid that she won't want her anymore?
"Host! Even if you get the Childbirth Pill like this, no one will have a child with you, so what's the use! Chu Fengmian is also the male protagonist after all, so you just have to be patient and coax him first!" The system was still thinking.
Song Qiao opened the door directly and left without hesitation.
There was a glimmer of light in her eyes.
She was just trying it out, but she didn't expect it to be able to complete the task.
Then this childbirth pill... may not be inoperable.
Song Qiao's eyes moved, interrupting the system's musings: "What are the specific rules for using the Childbirth Pill? Please explain in detail."
The voice of the system suddenly became cheerful: "Host, have you finally figured it out? I will explain it to you now.
The method of using the fertility pill is very simple. As long as you, the host, take this pill and have sex with the opposite sex, you will be 100% able to conceive a child. The better the talent and strength of the child's father, the greater the probability that the child will have high talent. After that, as the host, you just need to train the child well. The more powerful the child is, the host you will also be promoted! "
Song Qiao listened carefully, and then asked: "What if I give the fertility pill to someone else? Will it be effective?"
The system was stunned for a moment, and then said: "It takes effect. There was once a host who did this. She gave the Childbirth Pill to a friend, and after the friend gave birth to the child, she even more carefully cultivated the child. But the child was not her biological child, and she never raised it well. The child disliked her for taking too much care, and actually teamed up with his biological mother to kill the host. That host... tsk tsk tsk, it's thankless for all the trouble, this host is really pitiful.
After that, no host would give the Childbirth Pill to others. "
"Then it can be eaten by others." Song Qiao ignored the system and directly came to the conclusion.
The system couldn't help but feel depressed: "Host, did you listen to me?"
Song Qiao already had a plan in his mind and just ignored the system's words.
She hadn't walked a few steps when suddenly, a cold voice rang out.
"Junior sister Song."
Song Qiao raised his head and saw a cold, aloof and beautiful face.
A mechanical sound rang out.
[Dip, a genius who meets the conditions has been detected. 】
[Li Mo: Senior Brother of Lingxin Sect. Spiritual root: superior. Mind: Super. Comprehension: Superior. Root bone: superior. Luck: Moderate. 】
[Trigger the Tianjiao strategy mission: hug Li Mo affectionately for ten seconds. Mission reward: Water of Evolution. Let a newborn child drink the water of evolution, and there is a chance that the child's qualifications will be improved. 】
[Task time limit: one month. If it is not completed within one month, the task will disappear. 】
As soon as the mechanical sound ends.
